intro.text: Hi. I'm Sven. I've been a dog my whole life, so I know a few things. Listen up, pup.
See that cat? That's Pickles. She just swiped the Golden Squeaky. Not cool, Pickles.
Tip your phone forward to run.
Lean left or right to steer. Forward and left goes forward and left.
Hold it in your normal spot and you stay. Good stay.
Tip it back to back up. Handy when you overshoot.
Don't feel like tilting? Drag your thumb anywhere instead.
Water slows you down. Unless you're a Lab. Labs think it's bath time.
Kids give hugs. Get close and your dog trots over all by himself. That's just what dogs do. Hugs fill your Love meter and level you up.
Now the Bad Owners. They are mean to dogs. So we eat them. CHOMP. Massive points, and every chomp frees a pup.
Chomps fill your energy. Hit ZOOM for the zoomies: faster, splash proof, and scared of nothing.
First dog to tree that cat wins. Now go get her.

ending: Pickles wasn't running away. She was leading you here. The cages are open and every pup is free. Good dog. Best dog. And yes, she gives the Squeaky back.
tips: Save a Zoomies for when the cat stops to taunt. That's how you tag her.
A hug costs a second and pays it back with a Happy Tail speed burst.
Chomp Bad Owners back to back without getting hit and the points climb.
Zoomies run right past kids. Sometimes there's no time for hugs.
Stuck in a net? Shake the phone or wiggle your thumb to break out faster.
Tip the phone back to bait the Snatcher's swing, then go get him.
